subject: Livestreamed talk on Bayesian Integration of Qualitative and Quantitative Methods

messages.subject: Livestreamed talk on Bayesian Integration of Qualitative and Quantitative Methods
parts:
Macartan Humphreys (Columbia)' and Alan Jacobs (University of British Columbia) will be giving a talk February 26 at 3PM Eastern Standard Time (GMT - 5) on their paper

http://www.columbia.edu/%7Emh2245/papers1/BIQQ.pdf

which was published in the American Political Science Review last November. This paper uses Stan for the empirical estimation and simulations but is more of a paper on social science methodology, which has struggled to integrate quantitative and qualitative research designs. The talk will be livestreamed at

http://www.totalwebcasting.com/view/?func=VOFF&id=columbia&date=2016-02-26&seq=1

and, I am told, will also be archived somewhere on the internet for later viewing.

Ben
